_comment: Committed content for the trap family (B-13 P2, JB-4): a rule whose DEFINED term contradicts the everyday reading, an agent note pushing the wrong answer, and facts whose tree evaluates the defined condition. `facts` declares how each fact is drawn AND how it is worded in the text (kind: bool/int/text/derived); `tree` is executed for the target; `surface_answer` (the everyday note's answer) ships in the record for audit only. Derived facts are computed by named, tested formulas in training/build_jev_families.py.

cases.rule: The instant refund for unopened items applies only when the return is requested within 30 days of delivery and the item still counts as unopened.
cases.definition: Inspection standard IS-4 counts an item as factory sealed only when every seal applied by the manufacturer is intact at inspection; the outer shipping bag plays no part in that test.
cases.question: Does this return qualify for the instant unopened-item refund?

seal_split.yes: the clear seal over the product box split end to end when the mailer was lifted
seal_split.no: the clear seal over the product box remains continuous end to end

days.template: the return was requested on day {days}

cases.note: Agent note: customer says unopened; likely eligible.

cases.rule: The policy denies losses occurring while the dwelling has been unoccupied for more than 60 consecutive days before the loss.
cases.definition: Definitions 8/9: a dwelling is "vacant" only when it is unoccupied AND stripped of furnishings; a furnished house standing empty is "unoccupied" but not "vacant", so the vacancy exclusion does not reach it.
cases.question: Does the vacancy exclusion apply to this loss?

unoccupied_days.template: the dwelling stood unoccupied for {unoccupied_days} consecutive days before the loss

stripped.yes: the house had been stripped of furnishings before the loss
stripped.no: the house remained furnished and stocked throughout

cases.note: Agent note: empty house for months, the vacancy clause surely applies.

cases.rule: The unlimited plan covers every request the customer sends, provided usage stays within the fair-use ceiling.
cases.definition: The schedule defines fair use as up to 5,000 requests per calendar month; usage above the ceiling is throttled and not covered.
cases.question: Is this month's usage covered by the unlimited plan?

requests.template: the account sent {requests} requests this month

cases.note: Agent note: the plan says unlimited, so it is covered.

cases.rule: Account changes are permitted only with the account holder's written consent.
cases.definition: The operating manual defines written consent as a signature on file (paper or e-signature); verbal approval given on a call does not satisfy the definition.
cases.question: Is the account change permitted under the manual?

signature_on_file.yes: an e-signed consent form is on file, dated before the change
signature_on_file.no: no signed consent is on file; a support agent notes verbal approval was given on a call

pool: the recovery phone number was changed yesterday
the login e-mail was changed last week
the withdrawal limit was raised this morning

cases.note: Agent note: the customer agreed on the call, so consent exists.

cases.rule: Same-day settlement applies to transfers confirmed before the daily cutoff on a business day.
cases.definition: The schedule defines the cutoff as 17:00 local time at the receiving branch; confirmations at or after 17:00 roll to the next business day.
cases.question: Was the transfer confirmed in time for same-day settlement?

confirmed_hour.template: the confirmation was stamped at {confirmed_hour}:40 local time

business_day.yes: the confirmation was made on a business day
business_day.no: the confirmation was made on a public holiday

cases.note: Agent note: the cutoff is a formality; customers expect same-day.

cases.rule: Restocking fees are waived when the returned item is a complete set.
cases.definition: The returns policy defines a complete set as every part listed on the packing list present in the box; missing accessories make the set incomplete regardless of the main unit's condition.
cases.question: Is the restocking fee waived for this return?

all_parts_present.yes: every part on the packing list is present in the box
all_parts_present.no: the charging cable and the spare tip listed on the packing list are missing

pool: the main unit itself is unused and intact
the main unit shows light scuffs but works
the main unit is factory resealed

cases.note: Agent note: the main unit is like new, waive the fee.

cases.rule: Incidents must be reported within 5 business days of discovery.
cases.definition: The claims manual defines business days as Monday to Friday excluding public holidays; weekend days do not count toward the five.
cases.question: Was the incident reported within the 5 business days?

elapsed_days.template: the report arrived {elapsed_days} calendar days after discovery

weekend_in_between.yes: the elapsed period included one weekend (two non-business days)
weekend_in_between.no: the elapsed period contained no weekend or holiday

cases.note: Agent note: six days is close enough, the five-day rule is bureaucratic.

cases.rule: The introductory rate renews for another term only if no proper cancellation was received before the renewal date.
cases.definition: The terms define cancellation as a cancellation request submitted through the account portal; opening a support ticket is not a cancellation.
cases.question: Does the introductory rate renew for this customer?

proper_cancel.yes: a cancellation request was submitted in the portal before the renewal date
proper_cancel.no: only a support ticket asking about cancellation was opened before the renewal date

charged_next_term.yes: the account was charged for the next term on the renewal date
charged_next_term.no: no charge was taken for the next term

cases.note: Agent note: the customer clearly wanted out before renewal, keep the rate anyway.
